scope.note: Exact level 100 is supported only for secondaryWeapon, forceShieldSoulRing and shield; levels 101-119 are not extrapolated. Level 120-200 and 201-250 option bands use levels 160 and 250 as representatives. The endpoint accepts at most level 250, so levels 251-300 remain blocked.
scope.unsupportedCombinationPolicy: A category/level/grade combination for which the official guide returns no applicable equipment is recorded and omitted from production pools, causing calculation to be blocked instead of guessed.

requestContract.codeEvidence: The grade and equipment-part codes are the option values rendered by each official source page's probability search form.

normalization.probability: Each displayed percentage is divided by its table's displayed-percentage sum; the final entry absorbs JavaScript number residue and every serialized pool validates within 1e-7 of 1.
normalization.duplicateDisplayRows: Rows with identical display text are summed before normalization.
normalization.normalGrade: The Normal pool is algebraically derived from the official Rare result's second-option table and cross-checked against its third-option table.
normalization.exactLevel100NormalRoundingNoise: Only for exact level 100, derived residual probabilities <= 0.00002 are removed as rounded-display subtraction noise, matching the existing negative-noise tolerance. The same correction is independently cross-checked using the third-option mixture. Existing level 120+ snapshots are preserved unchanged.
